about: Harrison Cutfield & Co is a boutique real estate practice on Auckland's North Shore, built on a simple belief: a home this considered deserves to be sold with the same care it was lived in.
We don't do cookie cutter. Every campaign is bespoke, with sharp marketing, honest advice, and a small specialist team that shares one standard: doing right by every client.
The result is real estate that feels calm, confident and clear from first conversation to final signature, and a result that speaks quietly for itself.
